text: maya: FYI opened PR #512 to add a JS SDK snippet + migration notes. netlify preview failed on an image and linkcheck flagged missing anchor. looking for a reviewer who can help unblock tonight. oliver: share the netlify log? can reproduce locally usually. maya: netlify-bot pasted this: Build failed — 1 error. 404: /assets/images/sdk-flow.png referenced in docs/getting-started.md at line 42. Linkcheck warnings: missing anchor '#sdk-init-js' in docs/sdk.md. jen: likely path mismatch again. PR moves examples under docs/static/images but references still use /assets/images. prefer updating markdown to use relative paths `![](../static/images/sdk-flow.png)` or `/static/images/...` depending on mkdocs config. liam: for a fast local replicate i use docker: `docker run --rm -v $PWD/docs:/docs -w /docs python:3.10 bash -c "pip install -r requirements.txt && mkdocs build"` that mirrors netlify environment better. saved me a ton. maya: thanks. i'll add a Local Preview section to the PR with both pip and docker commands. can someone patch the anchor too? oliver: i'll add a tiny JS snippet and the missing anchor in docs/sdk.md: `## SDK init (JS)` plus small code: ```javascript import Redwood from 'redwood-sdk'; const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY }); ``` docs-ci: linkcheck re-run requested by oliver on PR #512. vercel-bot: Vercel preview deployed — URL: https://pr-512.preview.vercel.app. Note: Vercel build uses `mkdocs build` with Python 3.10. netlify-bot: Netlify deploy queued. jen: quick content note: in migration guide we call out token rotation tradeoffs. pls soften phrasing: "Consider rotating tokens more aggressively" -> "For some workloads, shorter-lived tokens reduce blast radius; evaluate cost of refresh frequency." maya: updated wording. pushed. liam: i pulled the branch and ran docker build — the 404 is gone after switching to `/static/images/sdk-flow.png`. mkdocs build exits 0. linkcheck still complains about `#sdk-init-js` because header uses `### SDK initialization (JS)` so anchor slug is different. i added an explicit anchor: `` above the header. oliver: ugh mkdocs slugging is annoying. prefer editing the header text to `### SDK init (JS)` so anchor auto matches. will change that instead of raw HTML. jen: we should avoid raw HTML in docs if possible. thanks oliver. vercel-bot: Preview updated build succeeded. netlify-bot: Deploy preview updated — build succeeded. Linkcheck warnings cleared. maya: great. who can review the migration guide + SDK snippet? need one content and one eng review. oliver: eng review done, left a couple small wording nits. jen: content review done LGTM. i'll merge in the 19:00 PT merge window if CI stays green. docs-ci: CI status: all checks passed on PR #512. merge queued for 19:00 PT. maya: thanks all. i'll follow up tomorrow to update example repo paths and add a short note to the docs contributor guide about using docker for local parity. liam: also added a one-liner in the PR description about how to flush netlify cache if anyone hits stale asset issues: `curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $NETLIFY_TOKEN" https://api.netlify.com/build_hooks/` jen: perfect. merging at 19:00. :shipit:
